change_summary: Research-only NBA ingestion guard at the board-loader boundary, isolated from #536. Rejects Tie/Draw in two-way ML, three-way, incomplete, duplicate, ambiguous, mixed-period, unsupported-period, fractional/malformed American odds and invalid-line contracts before pricing, for every source kind. models/nba/sportsedge_nba_model.py (blob b353de86) is not edited. PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED.
assumptions: Guard sits in front of the frozen pricer; direct calls to frozen run_card/price_games/price_game_market/__main__ remain for frozen-file tests and are not guarded. A census test fails if any other script or workflow runs the frozen pricer.

Tie/Draw semantics follow DraftKings General Rules C.ii (two-selection market with no Tie/Draw settles a tie as Push), cited in pr-536.json with URLs, retrieval times and sha256. A Tie selection never reaches two-way pricing.
Prices must be whole-number American quotes with abs value >= 100. PDF and screenshot inputs fail closed unless structured odds rows are supplied; no parser is added.
Not implemented: capture-time chronology and source authentication. This guard validates structure only, not quote provenance, authentication or freshness.
No promotion, no certification, no source authentication, official_counted=0, approved_stake_u=0, PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED.
